title: The Jealousy of God
definition: God's jealousy is His righteous demand for the exclusive worship, love, and devotion that belong to Him alone.
summary: God is not jealous in a sinful human way. He rightly opposes idolatry because He alone is God and He loves His people too much to leave them enslaved to false gods.
christFocus: Christ calls His followers to wholehearted devotion and loyalty to God above every idol.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is not jealous in a sinful human way. He rightly opposes idolatry because He alone is God and He loves His people too much to leave them enslaved to false gods.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
